body.en: Pichai announced Project Suncatcher, Google's initiative to test TPU-based AI compute in space, a concrete step in his infrastructure bet on Gemini.
body.zh: 皮查伊宣布了"Suncatcher"计划，谷歌将测试在太空部署基于TPU的AI算力，这是他押注Gemini基础设施战略的具体一步。

title.en: Sundar Pichai Among Tech Leaders Invited to Xi White House Dinner
title.zh: Sundar Pichai Among Tech Leaders Invited to Xi White House Dinner

body.en: Pichai was among the tech leaders invited to a White House dinner honoring Chinese President Xi Jinping.
body.zh: 皮查伊是受邀出席白宫为中国国家主席习近平举行晚宴的科技领袖之一。

title.en: Nearly 90% of the Fortune 100 Now Use Sundar Pichai's Gemini Enterprise Tool. Here's Why That Adoption Rate Matters for Alphabet Investors.
title.zh: Nearly 90% of the Fortune 100 Now Use Sundar Pichai's Gemini Enterprise Tool. Here's Why That Adoption Rate Matters for Alphabet Investors.

body.en: Nearly 90% of the Fortune 100 now use Google's Gemini Enterprise tool, a major enterprise-adoption milestone under Sundar Pichai.
body.zh: 财富100强企业中近90%已在使用谷歌的Gemini Enterprise工具，这是Sundar Pichai治下的一项重要企业采用里程碑。

title.en: 'Improve people’s lives': Sundar Pichai outlines Google’s big AI push across health, weather and education
title.zh: 'Improve people’s lives': Sundar Pichai outlines Google’s big AI push across health, weather and education

body.en: Pichai outlined Google's AI push across health, weather forecasting and education as part of the company's broader strategy to "improve people's lives."
body.zh: 皮查伊阐述了谷歌在健康、天气预测和教育领域的AI布局，作为公司"改善人们生活"整体战略的一部分。

title.en: Sundar Pichai Says Alphabet's Cloud Backlog Hit $514 Billion After 82% Revenue Growth Last Quarter. Is Google Cloud Becoming a Bigger Growth Driver Than Search?
title.zh: Sundar Pichai Says Alphabet's Cloud Backlog Hit $514 Billion After 82% Revenue Growth Last Quarter. Is Google Cloud Becoming a Bigger Growth Driver Than Search?

body.en: Pichai said Alphabet's cloud backlog reached $514 billion after 82% revenue growth last quarter, underscoring Cloud's growing weight versus Search.
body.zh: 皮查伊表示，在上季度云业务营收增长82%后，Alphabet的云业务积压订单已达5140亿美元，凸显云业务相对搜索业务日益增长的重要性。

title.en: Sundar Pichai Says Alphabet's Cloud Backlog Hit $514 Billion After 82% Revenue Growth Last Quarter. Is Google Cloud Becoming a Bigger Growth Driver Than Search?
title.zh: Sundar Pichai Says Alphabet's Cloud Backlog Hit $514 Billion After 82% Revenue Growth Last Quarter. Is Google Cloud Becoming a Bigger Growth Driver Than Search?

body.en: Pichai said Alphabet's cloud backlog reached $514 billion after 82% revenue growth last quarter.
body.zh: 皮查伊表示，在上季度云业务收入增长82%后，Alphabet云业务积压订单已达5140亿美元。

title.en: Google launches AlphaGenome Atlas, a map of human DNA: What CEO Sundar Pichai and Google DeepMind chief s
title.zh: Google launches AlphaGenome Atlas, a map of human DNA: What CEO Sundar Pichai and Google DeepMind chief s

body.en: Google launched AlphaGenome Atlas, a public map of human DNA variant effects, framed as a joint effort by Pichai and Google DeepMind's leadership.
body.zh: 谷歌发布AlphaGenome Atlas，一份公开的人类DNA变异影响图谱，报道将其视为皮查伊与谷歌DeepMind领导层的共同成果。

title.en: Sundar Pichai's Gemini App Grew From 400 Million to Over 1 Billion Monthly Users in a Little Over a Year. Does That Adoption Curve Justify Alphabet's AI Spending Binge?
title.zh: Sundar Pichai's Gemini App Grew From 400 Million to Over 1 Billion Monthly Users in a Little Over a Year. Does That Adoption Curve Justify Alphabet's AI Spending Binge?

body.en: The Gemini app grew from 400 million to over 1 billion monthly users in just over a year, a milestone cited in analysis of Alphabet's AI spending.
body.zh: Gemini应用的月活跃用户数在一年多时间里从4亿增长到超过10亿，这一里程碑被用于分析Alphabet的AI支出。

title.en: Sundar Pichai's Gemini App Grew From 400 Million to Over 1 Billion Monthly Users in a Little Over a Year. Does That Adoption Curve Justify Alphabet's AI Spending Binge?
title.zh: Sundar Pichai's Gemini App Grew From 400 Million to Over 1 Billion Monthly Users in a Little Over a Year. Does That Adoption Curve Justify Alphabet's AI Spending Binge?

body.en: The Gemini app grew from 400 million to over 1 billion monthly active users in a little over a year under Pichai, a milestone cited as validation of Alphabet's AI spending.
body.zh: 在皮查伊领导下，Gemini应用月活跃用户在一年多时间里从4亿增长到超过10亿，这一里程碑被视为对Alphabet巨额AI投入的验证。

title.en: Sundar Pichai Told Employees Waymo Could 'Meaningfully' Contribute to Alphabet's Financials as Soon as 2027. Is the Self-Driving Bet Underrated by the Market Today?
title.zh: Sundar Pichai Told Employees Waymo Could 'Meaningfully' Contribute to Alphabet's Financials as Soon as 2027. Is the Self-Driving Bet Underrated by the Market Today?

body.en: Pichai told Google employees Waymo could meaningfully contribute to Alphabet's financials as soon as 2027, a rare specific timeline for the self-driving unit's path to profitability.
body.zh: 皮查伊向谷歌员工表示，Waymo最快可能在2027年对Alphabet财报做出"有意义"的贡献，这是首次为自动驾驶业务的盈利路径给出具体时间表。

title.en: Sundar Pichai Says Alphabet Can't Build AI Capacity Fast Enough, and Anthropic Has Secured 5 Gigawatts of It.
title.zh: Sundar Pichai Says Alphabet Can't Build AI Capacity Fast Enough, and Anthropic Has Secured 5 Gigawatts of It.

body.en: Pichai said Alphabet cannot build AI computing capacity fast enough, noting that Anthropic alone has secured 5 gigawatts of it.
body.zh: 皮查伊表示Alphabet的AI算力建设速度跟不上需求，并指出仅Anthropic一家就已锁定5吉瓦的算力。

title.en: Sundar Pichai Says Alphabet's AI Overviews Now Reach 2.5 Billion Monthly Users as Ad Revenue Hit $82 Billion. Does That Scale Justify Spending Up to $205 Billion on AI Infrastructure This Year?
title.zh: Sundar Pichai Says Alphabet's AI Overviews Now Reach 2.5 Billion Monthly Users as Ad Revenue Hit $82 Billion. Does That Scale Justify Spending Up to $205 Billion on AI Infrastructure This Year?

body.en: Pichai said Google's AI Overviews now reach 2.5 billion monthly users as ad revenue hit $82 billion, raising the question of whether that scale justifies up to $205 billion in AI infrastructure spending this year.
body.zh: 皮查伊表示谷歌AI Overviews月活跃用户已达25亿，广告收入达到820亿美元，这一规模能否支撑今年高达2050亿美元的AI基础设施投入也随之成为焦点。

title.en: Sundar Pichai Says Alphabet Can't Build AI Capacity Fast Enough, and Anthropic Has Secured 5 Gigawatts of It.
title.zh: Sundar Pichai Says Alphabet Can't Build AI Capacity Fast Enough, and Anthropic Has Secured 5 Gigawatts of It.

body.en: Pichai said Alphabet can't build AI compute capacity fast enough, noting Anthropic has secured 5 gigawatts, underscoring the industry-wide race for compute.
body.zh: 皮查伊表示Alphabet的AI算力建设跟不上需求，并提到Anthropic已锁定5吉瓦算力，凸显整个行业的算力争夺战。

title.en: NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman joins Elon Musk and Sundar Pichai in their Space data center plans; say
title.zh: NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman joins Elon Musk and Sundar Pichai in their Space data center plans; say

body.en: NASA administrator Jared Isaacman joined Musk and Pichai's plans to build data centers in space, extending Google's Project Suncatcher initiative.
body.zh: NASA局长贾里德·艾萨克曼加入马斯克与皮查伊的太空数据中心计划,是对Google"Suncatcher计划"的进一步推进。

title.en: Over 8.5 million developers use Google AI models monthly; Alphabet plans $190 billion capex: Sundar Pichai
title.zh: Over 8.5 million developers use Google AI models monthly; Alphabet plans $190 billion capex: Sundar Pichai

body.en: Pichai put Alphabet's AI capital spending at roughly $190 billion and said 8.5 million developers now use Google's models every month.
body.zh: 皮查伊表示 Alphabet 的 AI 资本开支约为 1900 亿美元，并称目前每月有 850 万开发者使用谷歌模型。

title.en: Sundar Pichai Raised Alphabet's 2026 Capex Forecast to as Much as $205 Billion, Sending the Stock Down 7%. Was That an Overreaction That Investors Should Buy Into?
title.zh: Sundar Pichai Raised Alphabet's 2026 Capex Forecast to as Much as $205 Billion, Sending the Stock Down 7%. Was That an Overreaction That Investors Should Buy Into?

body.en: Pichai raised Alphabet's 2026 capital expenditure forecast to as much as $205B for AI infrastructure, sending the stock down 7%.
body.zh: 皮查伊将Alphabet 2026年资本支出预测上调至最高2050亿美元,用于AI基础设施建设,消息导致股价下跌7%。

title.en: Google Lost About $186 Billion After 4 of Its Top AI Researchers Left, but Sundar Pichai Says Google Will Be ‘A Founding Investor’ Anyway
title.zh: Google Lost About $186 Billion After 4 of Its Top AI Researchers Left, but Sundar Pichai Says Google Will Be ‘A Founding Investor’ Anyway

body.en: After four senior Google AI researchers left, Pichai said Google would still back their new venture as a founding investor.
body.zh: 在四位谷歌资深 AI 研究员离职后，皮查伊表示谷歌仍将作为创始投资方支持他们的新公司。

title.en: 'One of the most important updates': Sundar Pichai announces new Gboard feature that turns sign language
title.zh: 'One of the most important updates': Sundar Pichai announces new Gboard feature that turns sign language

body.en: He personally announced a Gboard feature that converts sign language, calling it one of Google's most important accessibility updates.
body.zh: 他亲自宣布 Gboard 新增手语转换功能，并称这是谷歌最重要的无障碍更新之一。

title.en: Sundar Pichai says Google Gemini AI hit 1 billion users
title.zh: Sundar Pichai says Google Gemini AI hit 1 billion users

body.en: Pichai says Gemini has reached one billion users, a scale marker for Google's AI pivot.
body.zh: 皮查伊称 Gemini 用户数已达十亿，这是谷歌 AI 转型的一个规模标志。

title.en: Alphabet CEO Sundar Pichai Just Made a $200 Billion Infrastructure Move. Nvidia, Micron, and Broadcom Investors Should Rejoice.
title.zh: Alphabet CEO Sundar Pichai Just Made a $200 Billion Infrastructure Move. Nvidia, Micron, and Broadcom Investors Should Rejoice.

body.en: Pichai committed Alphabet to a $200 billion infrastructure investment, one of the largest capital commitments tied to Google's AI buildout.
body.zh: 皮查伊承诺Alphabet投入2000亿美元用于基础设施建设，这是与谷歌AI扩张相关的最大规模资本投入之一。

title.en: Google CEO Sundar Pichai on the one AI race Google is ‘losing’ to Anthropic and OpenAI, says: We maybe di
title.zh: Google CEO Sundar Pichai on the one AI race Google is ‘losing’ to Anthropic and OpenAI, says: We maybe di

body.en: Pichai acknowledged Google was "losing" one part of the AI race to Anthropic and OpenAI, a rare public admission of a competitive gap.
body.zh: 皮查伊承认Google在AI竞赛的某一领域正"落后于"Anthropic和OpenAI,这一公开表态较为罕见。

title.en: Sundar Pichai: Public Right to be Concerned About AI
title.zh: Sundar Pichai: Public Right to be Concerned About AI

body.en: Sundar Pichai said the public is right to be concerned about AI, a notable acknowledgment of AI safety worries from the CEO steering Google's Gemini push.
body.zh: Sundar Pichai表示公众对AI感到担忧是合理的，这是这位主导谷歌Gemini战略的CEO对AI安全担忧的一次公开认可。

title.en: Sundar Pichai: Google Search, AI agents, and tools will become one
title.zh: Sundar Pichai: Google Search, AI agents, and tools will become one

body.en: Sundar Pichai laid out a vision of Google Search, AI agents and tools converging into one experience, signaling where he's steering the product long-term.
body.zh: 皮查伊阐述了Google搜索、AI智能体与工具将融合为一体的愿景，显示了他对产品长期方向的把控。

title.en: Google staff urge CEO Sundar Pichai to refuse classified military AI work
title.zh: Google staff urge CEO Sundar Pichai to refuse classified military AI work

body.en: Google employees publicly pushed back on CEO Sundar Pichai, urging him to refuse classified military AI contracts — a notable internal dissent over AI ethics under his leadership.
body.zh: 谷歌员工公开要求CEO桑达尔·皮查伊拒绝接受涉密军事AI合同，这是其任内一次引人注目的AI伦理内部异议事件。
